description: This file defines the Notification controller class within the Opencart admin tool context. It handles listing, viewing details, and deleting notifications, including pagination and permission checks.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Controller class for managing notifications within the Opencart admin panel, including listing, viewing, and deleting notifications.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the main notification page with breadcrumbs and common page components.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to load the list of notifications.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notifications, processes the time ranges for each notification, and prepares data for the notification list view.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific notification and marks it as read.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected notifications after permission validation.
